boards.name: Social media calendar
boards.description: Plan social posts with their copy and imagery, day by day, with platforms, formats and status — the week on a calendar ruler.

cards.title: Social calendar — week of the farm stories
cards.body: Seven posts across Instagram and TikTok. Each card holds the copy; the image sits above it.

cards.title: How to use this template
cards.body: Write copy on the card exactly as it will be posted. Colour = status: sand drafting, sky ready, sage scheduled. Clips on the ruler are publish days.
